answer: Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 9 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in umber and haven lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the comet graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1503 impostors cost 1047 times the honest price and take 19 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
